summary: A square grid of numbered tiles. Each move slides every tile as far as it goes in one direction; two equal tiles that meet join into one with their sum, and a tile joins at most once per move. A move that changes nothing is not a move. After each move one new small tile appears on an empty cell. A target tile wins; the game ends when no direction changes the grid.

cells.looks: a cell showing a power of two; its colour follows the number
a cell hidden or caught mid-animation

state_fields.grid: the grid's rows from the top, each a list of cells from the left: 0 empty, a tile's number, null a cell nobody read
state_fields.score: the game's score as read, or null
state_fields.scene: the id of the scene the screen shows

actions.description: one arrow key (or one swipe on a touch screen) in the direction to slide

scenes.looks: the grid with the score above it
a notice over the grid that the target tile was made, offering to keep going
a notice over the grid that no move is left, offering to try again

meta_actions.description: close the win notice and keep playing the same game

size.description: cells on each side of the square grid

start_tiles.description: tiles on the grid when a game starts

spawn.description: the values a new tile can have, each with its relative chance; the chances only steer the search, a check accepts any listed value

goal_value: the largest tile on the board
